tasks.title: ngv2/poc_repair_loop.py — generate->detonate->repair closed loop (P4.3)
acceptance_criteria: A NEW single-file whole-file module ngv2/poc_repair_loop.py exists, transcribed BYTE-FOR-BYTE from the embedded artifact in the brief (no paraphrase, rename, reorder, re-indent, or regeneration).

Module exposes run_repair_loop(finding, target, *, runner=None, client=None, resolver=None, max_attempts=3, timeout_s=30.0, success_marker='VULNERABLE', expected_fs_signature='pwned_marker') -> RepairResult with the exact keyword-only signature.

Module defines dataclasses RepairResult and AttemptRecord, the RunnerFn = Callable[..., dict] alias, the helpers _default_runner and _build_feedback, the DEFAULT_MARKER/DEFAULT_FS_SIGNATURE constants, and __all__ = ['run_repair_loop', 'RepairResult', 'AttemptRecord', 'RunnerFn'].
Binds to the LIVE ngv2.poc_writer.draft_poc for synthesis (no re-implementation) and keeps ngv2.poc_runner_live.detonate_live as the default runner, imported LAZILY inside _default_runner.
Loop stops on a 'confirmed' verdict and otherwise threads _build_feedback(report) back into draft_poc as the feedback argument, retrying up to max_attempts; max_attempts < 1 raises ValueError.
Only stdlib + ngv2 imports are used (no new third-party imports); harmless payloads only; no new tests authored.

spec.objective: Create the new single-file module ngv2/poc_repair_loop.py as an exact byte-for-byte transcription of the embedded artifact in the P4.3 brief, implementing the bounded generate->detonate->observe->repair closed loop over an injected runner, satisfying the already-committed oracle tests/test_poc_repair_loop_wired.py.
functional_requirements: Emit ngv2/poc_repair_loop.py as a verbatim, byte-for-byte copy of the embedded artifact: identical module docstring, imports, constants, dataclasses, helpers, function body, and __all__ — no paraphrase or reformatting.

Expose run_repair_loop(finding, target, *, runner=None, client=None, resolver=None, max_attempts=3, timeout_s=30.0, success_marker=DEFAULT_MARKER, expected_fs_signature=DEFAULT_FS_SIGNATURE) -> RepairResult, calling draft_poc(finding, target, client=client, resolver=resolver, feedback=feedback) each attempt.

Define AttemptRecord (attempt, verdict, exit_code, stdout, stderr, fs_diff, feedback=None) and RepairResult (confirmed, attempts, artifact, report, history) with RepairResult.to_dict() returning {confirmed, attempts, verdict, history:[{attempt, verdict, exit_code}]}.

Provide _default_runner(poc, target_spec, *, timeout_s, success_marker, expected_fs_signature) that lazily imports and delegates to ngv2.poc_runner_live.detonate_live, and is used when runner is None.

Provide _build_feedback(report) returning the 'stderr: ...\nexit_code: ...\nfs-diff: ...' string assembled from report['stderr'], report['exit_code'], and report['fs_snapshot_diff'], with <none> fallbacks.

Implement the loop control: raise ValueError when max_attempts < 1; build target_spec = {'repo_root': target.repo_root}; on verdict == 'confirmed' return confirmed RepairResult immediately; otherwise set feedback = _build_feedback(report) and continue; after the budget is spent return a non-confirmed RepairResult carrying the last artifact/report and full history.
spec.interfaces: ngv2/poc_repair_loop.py exposes run_repair_loop(finding, target, *, runner=None, client=None, resolver=None, max_attempts=3, timeout_s=30.0, success_marker='VULNERABLE', expected_fs_signature='pwned_marker') -> RepairResult, plus dataclasses RepairResult and AttemptRecord, the RunnerFn = Callable[..., dict] alias, constants DEFAULT_MARKER='VULNERABLE' and DEFAULT_FS_SIGNATURE='pwned_marker', and the private helpers _default_runner and _build_feedback.
edge_cases: max_attempts < 1 must raise ValueError before any drafting/detonation.
A report missing the 'verdict' key (report.get('verdict') is None) is treated as non-confirmed and triggers repair feedback.
Empty/None stderr and falsy fs_snapshot_diff must render as '<none>' in _build_feedback.
On the first attempt feedback is None so draft_poc is called with feedback=None.
When the budget is exhausted without 'confirmed', the returned RepairResult.attempts equals max_attempts and history holds one AttemptRecord per attempt.
non_goals: Do NOT author any new tests — the oracle tests/test_poc_repair_loop_wired.py is already committed and IS the integration test.
Do NOT re-implement PoC synthesis; bind to the live ngv2.poc_writer.draft_poc.
Do NOT eagerly import ngv2.poc_runner_live at module top level; keep the import lazy inside _default_runner.
Do NOT add new third-party imports (stdlib + ngv2 only); no live detonation in this module's own tests.
Do NOT paraphrase, rename, reorder, re-indent, or 'improve' any line of the embedded artifact.
